payload.acceptance_criteria:
- When terminal-setup deploys Claude config and ~/.claude exists, it shall run basicly skills-user pinned to the tag the harness is installed at, with cli-tools and tool-<name> for each tool found on PATH or in ~/.local/bin.
- When run on a Windows host, it shall do this both inside the WSL distro and for the Windows-native home.
- When ~/.claude is missing, it shall skip with a message naming why.
- When the harness is upgraded, a test shall fail until the pin matches .basicly/state/install.json, and a test shall fail when a basicly tool- skill has no command mapping.
payload.description: When terminal-setup has installed the command-line tools, I want to give Claude Code the basicly cli-tools skill and one tool-<name> skill per tool present, so I can have an agent on any machine pick rg, fd, jq and the rest instead of slower defaults. basicly skills-user (v0.18.6+) projects catalog skills into ~/.claude/skills; a rerun with a smaller list prunes only the skills it wrote itself (checked on a scratch home: img-zoom survived, a dropped tool-fd was pruned). It must run on the Windows host for both the WSL guest and Windows-native, inside WSL, and on Linux and macOS, from a clone and from uvx. It is skipped when ~/.claude is missing, like the img-zoom skill. skills-user silently ignores an unknown skill name, so terminal-setup must never pass one.
payload.requirements: A tested terminal_setup change following the img-zoom skill pattern, verified for real on WSL and Windows-native from a clone and uvx, released as v0.8.0.
